verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail is a cloud virtual-mailbox SaaS with a web app and APIs, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking controls. Its privacy claims cover virtual addresses on public records and mail security (encryption, 2FA, access-controlled facilities), which are adjacent topics and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
